history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-23: zoo owner, "yes do those, actually since this is a low level problem you can make the game last less" (replay the divergent starts of #702's full tier with notes retained, shortened to 25,000 turns).
experiment.prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-23, after reading the cells (not the notes) of reborn-light-matrix-full (run 45082814576, borg-zoo#702): ctl 20 deaths, light 15, light+leash 24, 16 of the leash arm's deaths with max depth 1 against 9 for light and 12 for ctl; 64 starts never reach DL2 with the leash arm against 48 for light. The 49 starts are every classes-1800 start of that tier that died in ctl, light or light+leash. A diagnosis, not a sample: nothing here is a rate. Four arms, 25,000 turns (the game is deterministic, so every play is the same as the 100,000-turn game up to the cap; 17 of light+leash's 24 deaths come before 25,000 turns), evidence retained, 196 cells, specimen track-p 206cf4e7 (the build of the full tier). Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death or turn_cap (turn_cap at 25,000 here); plays of ctl and light match the full tier's keys (play_sha256) wherever the game is the same. Read per start from the notes: where the leash holds the Borg (kit and money checks, "leash" notes, turns spent at DL1, trips to town, what it fought) and what killed it; the leash alone against ctl and against light+leash, so the leash's own effect is apart from the radius's. Descriptive (RULES 14).
